Unmodified FluidR3_GM.sf2: 148398306 bytes
SF2 SHA-256: 74594e8f4250680adf590507a306655a299935343583256f3b722c48a1bc1cb0

The SF2 is bzip2-compressed losslessly. The compressed stream is split into
three consecutive asset fragments, each below GitHub's single-file size limit.
Concatenate FluidR3_GM.sf2.part0.bz2, part1.bz2, part2.bz2 before decompression.
The Android adapter streams all parts to one checksum-verified cached SF2;
it does not create the decompressed soundfont in the Java heap.
Actual preset/sample synthesis uses libVLC's bundled FluidLite backend.
